title: Validation failures return 422, not the 400 named in the task checklist
evidence: src/lib.rs:55-58 ApiError::Validation maps to StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY (422); REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify says rejection should be 400. 422 is semantically correct and documented in README.md, so validation itself (title/author required) is fully implemented.
suggestion: Optional: return 400 to match the checklist wording, or leave as 422 (defensible). No functional gap.

title: Robust input modelling beyond spec
evidence: src/lib.rs:32-38 BookInput uses Option fields so a missing required field yields a 422 validation error instead of a JSON parse error; validate() at src/lib.rs:129 trims whitespace and rejects blank strings.

title: Case-insensitive author filter and centralised error handling
evidence: src/lib.rs:199 author filter uses COLLATE NOCASE; src/lib.rs:52-74 ApiError implements IntoResponse for uniform JSON error responses.
